name: bluestep
description: BlueStep tooling for Claude Code — bluestep-tools for B6P component workspaces (spec-driven skills, b6p CLI integration, subagents, hooks, platform reference), core-tools for every other repo (core rule set, /repo-setup, /task, /plan), phi-guard for the write-time client-data check in B6P projects, and bluestep-one for building BlueStep One components.

plugins.name: bluestep-tools
plugins.description: Spec-driven BlueStep (B6P) development: /b6p-* platform CLI skills, the /spec-* workflow, BlueStep subagents, guardrail hooks, and an on-demand platform reference.

plugins.name: core-tools
plugins.description: Base workflow tooling for repos that are not BlueStep components: the core rule set, /repo-setup for a repo's own AGENTS.md and skills, /task and /plan, and the session-cost measurement script.

plugins.name: phi-guard
plugins.description: Write-time client-data check for B6P projects: blocks an agent's Edit or Write that looks like real client data in a committed file. Opt-in, installed per machine; acts only in B6P projects.

plugins.name: bluestep-one
plugins.description: Build BlueStep One components on Claude Code: /bluestep-one:setup for a component workspace, /bluestep-one:build to build, publish and check a component one gate at a time, an on-demand BlueStep One reference, and a tab guard for browser GraphQL calls. Needs bluestep-tools.
